constraints.name: appointments_assignee_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (assignee_id) REFERENCES user_profiles(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: appointments_company_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id) REFERENCES companies(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: fk_appointments_customer
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, customer_id) REFERENCES customers(company_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: fk_installations_appointment
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, customer_id, appointment_id) REFERENCES appointments(company_id, customer_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: fk_surveys_appointment
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, customer_id, appointment_id) REFERENCES appointments(company_id, customer_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

triggers.name: guard_survey_appointment_write
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER guard_survey_appointment_write BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON appointments FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION guard_survey_appointment_write()

triggers.name: trg_appointments_immutability
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_appointments_immutability BEFORE UPDATE ON appointments FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION enforce_appointments_immutability()

triggers.name: trg_tenant_mutation_appointments
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_tenant_mutation_appointments BEFORE UPDATE ON appointments FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION prevent_tenant_mutation()

triggers.name: trg_updated_at_appointments
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_updated_at_appointments BEFORE UPDATE ON appointments FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column()

indexes.name: appointments_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX appointments_pkey ON public.appointments USING btree (id)

indexes.name: idx_appointments_company_survey_created
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_appointments_company_survey_created ON public.appointments USING btree (company_id, created_at) WHERE (type = 'SURVEY'::text)

indexes.name: idx_appointments_technician
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_appointments_technician ON public.appointments USING btree (company_id, assignee_id, start_time)

indexes.name: uq_appointments_company_customer_id
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_appointments_company_customer_id ON public.appointments USING btree (company_id, customer_id, id)
